title: Find your next words
narration: LingoLive helps you learn a language through real conversations. Understand what was said, explore the words, and find a useful next reply.

title: Start simply
narration: Choose a language you understand and one you are learning. The first-use tutorial lets you tap a word and try pronunciation. This clearly labelled example needs no model call, microphone permission, or account.

title: Hear. Understand. Reply.
narration: Here is a Japanese question about coffee. This is a fresh response from the deployed Google model. The screen shows its meaning and three short replies. Every source and reply word can be tapped for an explanation.

title: Tap any word
note: Stored meanings · no extra AI call
narration: Switch to pronunciation to read unfamiliar script aloud. Word bubbles and pronunciation reuse the lesson already received. They do not make another paid model call. You can copy a reply or hear it with a device voice.

title: Replies follow your goal
narration: Now the learner wants tea to take away. When the conversation asks whether to eat here, that goal travels with recent turns and learner notes. Suggested replies can preserve the intention. Leave the goal empty, and the model instead infers a likely context. Suggestions remain separate from confirmed speech.

title: Keep what you learn
narration: Useful phrases are saved on this browser. Search them, reopen a lesson, or remove it. Learner profiles keep local notes and history separate. A new conversation clears the current scene while keeping saved learning. There is no cloud conversation-history database.

title: Speak into the app
narration: Now, synthesized English speech enters the real microphone worklet. Google transcribes it live, then generates Hindi explanations and suggested replies. These are real cloud responses.

title: Choose how to connect
note: Host code or your own Google key
narration: Connect with a host code or your Google key. Personal keys stay in expiring server memory, outside cookies and history. Failed keys never use host credentials.

title: Built on Google Cloud
narration: Cloud Run serves the website and protected APIs. Gemini Transcribe Live handles speech. Two parallel Flash-Lite calls produce source understanding and replies. The server checks complete word definitions and exact text.

title: Faster complete lessons
narration: Ten complete hosted lessons averaged one point seven nine seconds, with no failures. This small warm-path sample excludes cold starts. Authentication and usage limits remain.

title: Learn from the next conversation
note: AI Builder Cup · Ashish T. Vasant
narration: Explore LingoLive, a working Google Cloud prototype for everyday language learning.
